customer.target: Owners of small local businesses in Greater Manchester (cafés, salons, barbers, clinics, gyms, trades, estate agents, small shops) who have no website or one they're unhappy with

behaviours.name: Gets three quotes

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Paid a web designer before and the site was late, unfinished or held hostage; trusts nobody now.

behaviours.name: Word of mouth only

behaviours.name: Wants it done for them

pitch:
Bracket is Bilal, a freelance web developer who works remotely from Kuwait for small businesses in the UK, by WhatsApp, email and video call. No UK office, no UK clients or reviews yet. His site shows his photo, one real project (an online booking system with an owner dashboard for an air conditioning company in Kuwait, client kept anonymous) and a labelled demo website for a made-up plumber.
Websites from £655, built for phones and ready for Google. He can write the page text for you from one short call. After launch, a care plan is £43 a month for hosting, small fixes and updates. Ongoing SEO is optional, from £325 a month.
Founding client offer, first 5 clients only: no upfront payment. You agree the scope in writing, he builds the full site, you review it on his preview link with 2 rounds of changes included, and you pay only when you're happy, by bank transfer or PayPal. Your domain is registered in your name from the start; files and logins are handed over after payment; new pages or features outside the scope cost extra. In return, you agree to an honest public review if you're happy.
You find him through his website or Instagram @bracketkw.
